# accounting-spec

> The formal specification and machine-checked Lean 4 proofs for the
> WyattAu accounting estate: integer-minor-unit algebra, posting monoid,
> balance conservation, reversal cancellation, rounding, hash-chain
> tamper detection, each with its Rust mapping.

- [SPEC](SPEC.md): the normative specification; theorems proven in
  `lean/src/Accounting.lean`
- [lean/](lean/): Lean 4 core + `omega`; `sorry`-free build is the gate
- [ITERATIONS](ITERATIONS.md): research loop log
- [README](README.md): why, layout, proof-checking procedure
